name: checked-07-rust-command
what: What std::process::Command does on Windows with a turn's argument list and environment, checked with a launcher compiled for this (scripts/checked-launch.rs.txt, rustc 1.95): the argument list round trip, env_clear(), what spawn() returns when it cannot start the program, Child::kill(), a write to the stdin of a program that has exited; then the real codex started that way, with and without SYSTEMROOT, with CREATE_NO_WINDOW, ended with Child::kill() in the middle of a turn and with a command running; and what becomes of a child when its parent is killed, for a Node parent and for a Rust one.
